title: CHILD Act of 2026
subjects: Social work, volunteer service, charitable organizations
committees: H-Judiciary Committee: Referred To 2025-04-30 -> Markup By 2026-07-15 -> Reported By 2026-11-05
latest_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 770.
summary: This bill restores the authority for businesses and organizations that provide care or care placement services for children, the elderly, or individuals with disabilities (care-providing businesses and organizations) to request national criminal history background checks for contractors and for individuals they certify or license. Federal law authorizes care-providing businesses and organizations to request national criminal history background checks for certain covered individuals . From 1994 to 2018, covered individuals included three categories of individuals: (1) current or prospective employees or volunteers; (2) current or prospective owners or operators; and (3) anyone who had, may have had, or sought to have access to children, the elderly, or individuals with disabilities (e.g., contractors and licensees). In 2018, the Child Protection Improvements Act removed the third category
